description: This file defines the 'Controller' class within the OpenCart system, implementing a dependency injection pattern via a registry. It includes methods for accessing and modifying registry entries through magic methods.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Provides a base controller class that interacts with the Registry to manage dependencies and services within the OpenCart framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a Registry object to access shared services.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Retrieves a service or component from the registry by key, throwing an exception if it does not exist.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets a service or component in the registry with a specified key.
